sf-charter::1.100: The City and County of San Francisco shall continue as a consolidated City and County with such boundaries as are or may hereafter be established by law.
sf-charter::1.101: The City and County of San Francisco may make and enforce all ordinances and regulations in respect to municipal affairs, subject only to the restrictions set forth in this Charter. See Section 1.1 of the Transportation Code.
sf-transportation::1.1: (a) Whenever in this Transportation Code words or phrases are used that are not defined by the provisions of this Code, they shall have the meanings set forth in the Vehicle Code. (b) "Director of Transportation" means the Director of the Municipal Transportation Agency.
sf-transportation::1.2: In undertaking the adoption and enforcement of this Division I, the City is assuming an undertaking only to promote the general welfare. See Section 1.100 of the Charter.
sf-transportation::1.3: (a) The provisions of the San Francisco Transportation Code shall be construed in a manner consistent with the Vehicle Code of the State of California.
sf-transportation::1.4: Regulatory authority over motor vehicles for hire is hereby transferred to the Municipal Transportation Agency.
sf-transportation::1.5: If any provision of this Code is held unconstitutional or invalid, the remainder of the Code shall not be affected.
sf-transportation::1.6: This section shall take effect upon adoption.
